        return
    hanoi(n - 1, a, c, b, moves)
    moves.append(a + c)
    hanoi(n - 1, b, a, c, moves)

name: realistic: prime sieve
code:
n = 30
flags = [True] * (n + 1)
flags[0] = False
flags[1] = False
i = 2
while i * i <= n:
    if flags[i]:
        j = i * i
        while j <= n:
            flags[j] = False
            j += i
    i += 1
print([x for x in range(n + 1) if flags[x]])
